lines.en: I walk carrying my gear.
My feet are big and loud.
I count arrows as I walk.
My armor clatters.
I head out past the camp.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但很有底气
lines.en: Slow, but confident.
I cracked a paving stone.
I make for the noise.

lines.zh: 我跨过一条浅沟，溅起泥
lines.en: I step across a shallow ditch and splash mud.
I leave deep prints in the grass.
I turn past a row of stakes.

lines.zh: 我踩着草根，一步步逼近
lines.en: I tread the grass roots and close in step by step.
I am sharpening my blade.
I fletch an arrow with a fresh feather.
I crouch and study the ground.

lines.zh: 我在数皮袋里还剩几支箭
lines.en: I count how many arrows are left in the pouch.
I wait for someone to come.
I spit.
I count the pouches at my belt.
I lean against a stake.
There are footsteps beyond the trees, light ones.
I know this area well.
You carry no bow.
You do not look local.
I squint at you.
You carry a lot.
I can tell you fight.
You are holding the road I want.
I keep my blade sheathed, for now.
Your calluses are thick.

lines.zh: 先看你腰上挂的什么家伙
lines.en: First, what's hanging at your belt.
Take one step forward and see.
No need for words between us.
Put down your things and talk.

lines.zh: 我呸了一口，抹掉嘴角的血
lines.en: I spit and wipe the blood from my mouth.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我牙都松了
lines.en: That one loosened a tooth.
That hit armor.
I do not cry out in pain; I cry your name.

lines.zh: 这一下震得我虎口发麻
lines.en: The blow left my sword hand numb.
I spat out a mouthful of blood.
I have not gone down yet.
That was a good one.
I will settle this score.
Come on, keep it coming.
Toss it over, and don't dawdle.
I am not picky about anything.
Throw it over.
Let me check it for poison.
This could trade for a few arrows.
Why pull your hand back?
I will take half and that is fine.
You have some manners.
Eating it owes you nothing.
Another piece, then.
Doesn't the steel plate sting your arm?
I did not yield half a step.
My armor jabbed you.
Step back a little.
This frame can take a hit.
A solid collision.
You stepped on my boot.
The road is wide; do not crowd me.

lines.zh: 低头看看，你的水囊滚了
lines.en: Look down; your waterskin rolled off.
Look before you walk into someone.
I do not discuss such things.
The camp lacks hands, not this.
Let me finish the fight first.

lines.zh: 仗还没打完，说这个做什么
lines.en: The fight isn't over; why bring that up?
I mind my own business.
Save that question for someone else.

lines.zh: 这种事在酒馆里也说不得
lines.en: Not even in a tavern.
I still have a patrol.
I will pretend I did not hear.
I am heading back to camp.
I bent and picked it up.
This looks valuable.
Iron. Worth two jugs of drink.
Yours? Take it.
Holding it costs me nothing.
Finders keepers.
I toss it back to you.
Catch it; do not drop it.
You carry too much.
Do not blame others next time.

lines.zh: 草丛动了一下，我就知道
lines.en: The grass stirred; that told me enough.
Keep your hands away from your back.
Draw your weapon.
This ground is ours.
I strike at the count of three.
Leave and I will not follow.
My bow is drawn.
You will not slip past.

lines.zh: 你的手指往哪边动，我盯着
lines.en: I watch which way your fingers drift.
Strangers are not welcome here.
Walk away or fight.

lines.zh: 鼻子、疤痕，我都看清楚了
lines.en: The nose, the scar, I have them all.

lines.zh: 先报个数，你带了几个人
lines.en: Tell me the count: how many came with you?
Do not try to bargain with me.
My blade is already out of the sheath.
That is a poor spot to stand.

lines.zh: 我把刀横在身前，慢慢靠
lines.en: I bring my blade across and close in slowly.
Do not hide behind that post.
My arrow is nocked.
I count where your feet land.

lines.zh: 你换个方向，我也换个方向
lines.en: Change direction and I change with you.
We are few, but enough.

lines.zh: 我贴着木栅挪到你的盲角
lines.en: I slide along the fence into your blind side.
You will not climb that wall.
I hear you catch your breath.
The more you back off, the closer the fence.

lines.zh: 你脚一抬，我就钻进那道缝
lines.en: The moment you lift a foot, I take the gap.
This is not a negotiation.
You can't even hold your blade, and you'd block me?
I know this terrain.
There is one way back.
Keep your companions back.
I have both bow and blade.
I chop down with the blade.
That was a real blow.
You blocked it; your wrist will ache.
My blade's edge is not new.
You fell back three steps.
I follow with another.
Your armor dented inward.
You fight rather well.
I step back to shoot.
That arrow travels in an arc.
You dodged the first.
This bow of mine is not light.
You took an arrow in the shoulder.
I switched to my other hand.
Come close and I back off.
Let us fight somewhere else.
I come from the camp's edge.
This area is ours.
I heard a branch snap.
I loosen my blade in its sheath.
I take the middle of the road.
I am not alone on this plain.
This armor was taken.
I never knock before entering.
Did you hear the horn?
Let me see who you are first.
I walk toward you.
There is work today.
My plates are too hot to hold.
I fell and banged my knee.
My kind are poor swimmers.
The blast tore my armor loose.

lines.zh: 腿上一沉，我差点跪下去
lines.en: My leg buckled; I nearly dropped to a knee.
This sorcery is beyond me.
I have gone three days hungry.
Lightning left iron in my mouth.
There is not even a stone underfoot.
